陈洛兮看着看着就脸红了，王野赶紧系上扣子。看着发呆的陈洛兮，轻咳了一声。陈洛兮回过神来，她的脸瞬间更红了，像是春日里突然绽放的桃花，那一抹红晕从脸颊迅速蔓延至耳根，宛如天边的云霞不小心晕染到了她的面庞。

陈洛兮转头背对着王野慢慢往前走着，偷偷的深吸了两口气才缓过来。王野也跟了上去。陈洛兮见王野跟上来了就说：“要是练成这样那还是算了。就没有什么练了不这样的吗？”

王野想了一下，说：“也不是没有。”

这下陈洛兮又来了兴趣，赶紧追问：“有什么？简单吗？厉害吗？”

王野笑着说：“我知道两个，一个是太极拳。”

不等王野继续说，陈洛兮打断道：“这个我知道，一点儿都不厉害，大院里好多爷爷就练这个，慢吞吞的。”

“那是你没见过厉害的，真正的太极大家，二三十人都不能近身”

陈洛兮将信将疑的问：“那另一个呢？”

“另一个是咏春拳，这个拳法很适合女孩子练。动作相对来说比较小，多用巧劲儿。”

“那你会吗？你能教我吗？”

“我不会。”

“你不会有什么用呀？”

“我不会，但我可以学呀！”

“那你认识会咏春拳大师傅吗？”

“不认识呀！”

“啊啊啊！王野你是诚心气我的吧！”

“谁跟你说必须要有师傅教的呀？”

“不是说师傅领进门，修行靠个人的嘛！”

“对呀，我已经进门了呀！”

“对呀，你不用师傅教，你可以自己摸索，等你会了再教我，哇哇哇！我也可以成为高手了！”

“那你从哪儿学呀？”

“北海边上是四九图书馆，你去过吗？那里什么书都有，咱们下午去找找呀？”

“好呀好呀！要不现在咱就去吧？”

“小姑奶奶，我早上就没吃饭，你看看都几点了，咱能不能先去吃点东西呀？”

“对不起啊，我太激动了，没注意......”

“走吧！我记得天坛外面就有一个国营饭店，咱们去凑合吃点儿。”

“去饭店还是凑合呀？”

“饭店里的也就一般吧，其实在四九城还是有很多好吃的的，比如北京饭店的谭家菜，丰泽园的鲁菜，东来顺的火锅，都很好吃。”

陈洛兮好奇的问：“这些你都吃过呀？”

“没有呀！我只吃过东来顺。”

“没吃过你说好吃。”

“我是没吃过，可是我会做呀”

“什么？你会做？”陈洛兮声音都不自觉的大了。

“我会做很稀奇吗？”

Chen Luoxi blushed as she looked at it, and Wang Ye quickly buttoned it up.Looking at Chen Luoxi in a daze, she coughed lightly.When Chen Luoxi came to her senses, her face instantly turned redder, like a sudden bloom of peach blossoms in spring. The blush quickly spread from her cheeks to her ears, like the clouds in the sky accidentally smearing her face.

Chen Luoxi turned her back to Wang Ye and walked forward slowly, secretly taking two deep breaths to calm down.Wang Ye also followed.When Chen Luoxi saw Wang Ye following him, she said, "If you practice like this, forget it. Isn't there anything that can't be practiced like this?"

Wang Ye thought for a moment and said, "It's not impossible."

Now Chen Luoxi became interested again and quickly asked: "What is it? Is it simple? Is it powerful?"

Wang Ye smiled and said: "I know two, one is Tai Chi."

Before Wang Ye could continue, Chen Luoxi interrupted: "I know this. It's not great at all. There are many grandpas in the compound who practice this slowly."

"That's the most powerful person you've ever seen. A real Tai Chi master. Even twenty or thirty people can't get close to him."

Chen Luoxi asked doubtfully: "What about the other one?"

"The other is Wing Chun. This boxing method is very suitable for girls to practice. The movements are relatively small, and more skillful use is used."

"Then you know it? Can you teach me?"

"I won't."

"You won't be of any use?"

"I don't know how, but I can learn!"

"Then do you know a master of Wing Chun?"

"I don't know you!"

"Ah! Wang Ye, are you sincerely angry with me?"

"Who told you that you must have a master to teach you?"

"Isn't it said that the master will lead you in, and the practice depends on the individual!"

"Yes, I've already entered the door!"

"That's right, you don't need a master to teach you, you can explore on your own, and then teach me when you know how to do it. Wow, wow, wow! I can become a master too!"

"Then where did you learn it?"

"Next to Beihai is the Sijiu Library. Have you been there? There are all kinds of books there. Let's go look for them this afternoon?"

"Okay, okay! How about we go now?"

"Sister-in-law, I haven't eaten in the morning. Look at what time it is. Can we go get something to eat first?"

"I'm sorry, I was too excited and didn't pay attention..."

"Let's go! I remember there is a state-owned restaurant outside the Temple of Heaven. Let's go and have something to eat."

"Is it better to go to a restaurant?"

"The food in the hotel is just average. In fact, there are many delicious restaurants in Sijiucheng. For example, the Tanjia cuisine in Beijing Hotel, the Shandong cuisine in Fengzeyuan, and the hot pot in Donglaishun are all delicious."

Chen Luoxi asked curiously: "Have you eaten all of these?"

"No! I've only eaten Dong Lai Shun."

"I've never tasted it and you said it tasted delicious."

"I've never eaten it, but I can cook it."

"What? Can you do it?" Chen Luoxi's voice became louder unconsciously.

"Am I going to do something weird?"
